subphase: S64: replace per-recipe auxiliary-package pins with a versioned, content-addressed dependency registry

execution.note: all fetches, extractions, installs and builds ran inside the court container; no project build ran on the host

capability_model.request: a recipe names {"capability": <name>, "bundle": "cap:<name>@<version>"}; it never repeats a URL list
capability_model.bundle_contents: runtime library packages, development packages (headers and .so symlinks), pkg-config metadata and build tools, extracted into one install root

subject_isolation.where: downstream_deps.resolve -> _assert_subject_isolated on every resolve; build_link_findings/_dependency_registry_findings re-resolves every capability from --check
subject_isolation.mechanism: anchored basename match for libssl*/libcrypto*/openssl* over package names, URL basenames, the OpenSSL Debian pool path, declared include/library/pkg-config/bin dirs, link paths and link targets; libevent_openssl.so remains admissible as a subject consumer
subject_isolation.negative_control: a synthetic bundle containing libcrypto3 was refused by the resolver

version_coherence.static: validate_bundle: every component package's Debian filename version equals the declared debian_version and has the declared upstream_version prefix; runtime path basename equals the declared SONAME; the development link lies under a declared library dir; pkg-config and header expected versions match the declared relation; the bundle content hash is recomputed
version_coherence.dynamic: verify_installed, called by _prepare_aux after extraction: the pinned runtime exposes the declared SONAME; the development symlink resolves to the same ELF (or the declared external runtime); the installed .pc Version equals the pinned version; the header version macro equals the pinned version; declared tools exist and are executable
negative_controls: libevent.so repointed away from libevent-2.1.so.7 -> refused
all eight bundles installed and verified clean before the controls

source_immutability.where: assert_isolated_install_root before any extraction; assert_within_install_root before rewriting each .pc
source_immutability.mechanism: the install root may not equal, contain or sit inside the consumer source tree after symlink resolution; a .pc link that resolves outside the install root is refused
source_immutability.negative_control: an install root inside the source tree was refused; after all eight capability installs the sentinel source file was unchanged

reproducibility.mechanism: sha256 over canonical JSON of bundle id/version, package URLs and published SHA-256 digests, extraction argv, include/library/pkg-config/bin dirs, links and component evidence; resolve recomputes it and refuses a mismatch; each recipe names its exact bundle and each measured run records aux_bundles {capability, bundle_id, sha256}
reproducibility.negative_control: mutating one package digest invalidated the bundle content hash

reuse_proof.comparison_method: before/after atlas rows compared field by field: level, outcome, residual, DT_NEEDED, linkage (resolved paths and artifact SHA-256), evidence and every step's name/ok/exit_code/argv are identical; only elapsed_seconds and the new aux_bundles field differ

registry.note: the five autotools packages are defined once each and shared by the autotools and autotools-ltdl bundles

url_deduplication.projected_full_dedup: if all 147 legacy recipes migrated, 973 URL references become 247 registry references (74.6% fewer URL literals)

executor_compatibility.executor_unchanged_role: forensics/tools/downstream_build_link.py remains the executor; the registry is a pure resolver it imports
executor_compatibility.legacy_path: aux_sources still fetches, digest-checks and extracts exactly as before; a recipe may not mix capabilities and aux_sources (self-test and --check refuse it)

registry_self_test.output: [downstream-deps] self-test ok: 8 capabilities, 8 bundles, 30 package definitions (25 unique URLs), subject isolation, version coherence, source immutability and content addressing enforced

executor_self_test.output: [downstream-build-link] self-test ok: the guard refuses a host invocation ... and a candidate row that built a different pristine source tree) is caught with specificity holding

check.output: [downstream-build-link] with_recipe=307 candidate_linked=245 linkage_proven=245 findings=0 control honest=True

remeasure.note: --reuse-previous-candidate was required because the committed atlas was bound to a previous candidate install; the six target families were rebuilt, the other rows were reused with the explicit superseded-identity marker. The measurement was repeated against the final edited resolver (same six L4 grades, identical step argv/exit codes and artifact digests). The shared atlas was restored to its committed bytes afterwards so this subphase's diff is limited to the registry and executor.

install_verification.command: bl._prepare_aux on each of the eight capabilities with a disjoint source root
install_verification.result: PASS: all eight bundles installed, verify_installed returned no problems, and the sentinel source file was unchanged

unresolved: 147 recipes remain on the legacy aux_sources path; they are compatible but not deduplicated by this subphase

cap:pcre1@8.39-15 records three UNRESOLVED coherence axes: libpcre3 extracts its SONAME under lib/x86_64-linux-gnu while the legacy pin exposes usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu; Debian's libpcre.so is an absolute symlink to the venue; libpcre.pc is not on the legacy PKG_CONFIG_PATH. It is expressed but not migrated.

cap:libudev@252.39-1~deb12u2 records the runtime SONAME as the venue's libudev.so.1 (not a pinned runtime package) and libudev.h publishes no version macro; the development symlink and runtime presence are verified
cap:ncurses@6.4-4 tinfo component records that libtinfo-dev ships no separate version header; the pinned tinfo.pc Version and libtinfo SONAME are the evidence
cap:autotools-ltdl's libltdl component records that Debian ships no ltdl.pc and ltdl.h has no version macro; runtime/development package versions and the SONAME are the evidence
no package digest is UNRESOLVED: every package in every bundle has a published SHA-256, and none was invented
no bundle fetches or provides libssl, libcrypto or openssl
non_claims: a build/link result is not a functional proof; L4-linked is not L7
the three demonstrated capabilities prove these six families; they do not by themselves graduate the wider cohort
the registry validates dependency metadata and install layout, not the upstream packages' cryptographic correctness
